answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked in a public contract before it can claim rewards, and slash that bond when an auditor proves duplicate identities coordinated on the same task. A real participant can reuse one funded identity, but a sybil attacker must tie up separate capital for every fake and risks losing it; making identities on a marble terrace or across a tundra does not avoid the on-chain cost. This raises the price of multiplying influence rather than pretending to prove who is human.
